CustomField.formula: Name & " |" & IF(TEXT(Medium_s__c) = "Desktop", " Desktop " & Desktop_Size__c, IF(TEXT(Medium_s__c) = "Mobile", " Mobile " & Mobile_Size__c, IF(TEXT(Medium_s__c) = "Desktop & Mobile", " Desktop " & Desktop_Size__c & " & Mobile " & Mobile_Size__c, " No Size Found" )))
CustomField.label: Detailed Name
